name: AK36 - Indoor & Outdoor Thermo-Hygrometer (Temperature, Humidity, Heat Index), IP65 Waterproof
highlights: IP65 — Rated for Water and Dust — The only sealed enclosure in the catalogue. Greenhouses, bathrooms, garages, workshops, boat cabins and covered outdoor areas are all places a standard monitor does not survive.

Heat Index, Not Just Temperature — Thirty degrees at eighty percent humidity is a different proposition from thirty degrees at forty. The heat index combines both into the figure that actually describes how the air will feel and behave.
Flu Index — A combined temperature and humidity indication of the conditions in which airborne viruses persist — a reading aimed at nurseries, classrooms and care settings during winter.
Two AAA Cells — No charging and no cable, which is what makes a sealed enclosure worth having: nothing has to be opened.
50 Per Carton — 300 × 482 × 295 mm outer, 10 kg gross, 73 g per unit.
